newsitem.title: UK: Sugar freight remains slow but new orders cited.
newsitem.headline: Sugar freight remains slow but new orders cited.

text.p: Sugar freight business remained quiet on Wednesday but shipbrokers said increasing enquiries suggested that rates could begin to pick up.
Regular orders were reported out of Brazil but the Far East continued to be slow, they said.
There were no new fixtures on Wednesday but Czarnikow Rionda had a new order for 6,000 tonnes bagged sugar from north Brazil to the Mediterranean option West Africa prompt with seven days notice.
Sugar Exporters brought 8,700 tonnes bagged sugar from Santos to Lagos for September 10-15.
